title: Constrained carbon bonding inside fullerene cages
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00481K, Review Article
Yaoxiao Zhao, Mengyang Li, Wangqiang Shen, Kun Guo, Lipiao Bao, Xing Lu
Constrained carbon bonding within carbon cages unveils unprecedented carbon–metal interactions and multicentre bonding motifs, redefining the boundaries of carbon chemistry and unveiling new principles of molecular bonding.
